decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's established air-cooler and heat-exchange business, this product benefits from sunk engineering and manufacturing investment, fits the firm's publicly stated innovation path, and absent clear evidence of failure management would tend to continue and attribute any weakness to temporary market factors.

Because enhanced heat exchanger tubes are highly aligned with the firm's core technical capabilities, R&D orientation, and efficiency promise, management is likely to justify past investment and keep the product unless results clearly deteriorate, which is not shown here.
